transcript: Speaker A: यह कौन सी दवाई दे दी है तूने? पर्चे में तो कुछ और ही लिखा है। कितनी बार समझाऊं? तेरे दिमाग में कुछ घुसता क्यों नहीं? अगर इंग्लिश नहीं आती तो मेडिकल स्टोर पर काम क्यों करने चला आया गवार कहीं का? चल भाग यहां से। [What medicine have you given? Something else is written on the prescription. How many times do I explain? Why doesn't anything enter your brain? If you don't know English, why did you come to work at a medical store, you illiterate? Go, get out of here.] Speaker B: Sir, please don't talk to me like that. This is not my mistake. It's a doctor's mistake and he is the one who wrote it incorrectly. I will give the medicine according to what is written on the prescriptions. And yes, I'm not uneducated. I have three years of experience in pharma. Please speak respectfully from now on. Speaker A: अरे तुम तो अच्छी इंग्लिश बोलते हो, कहां से सीखा? [Oh, you speak good English, where did you learn?] Speaker B: सर, जब मैंने इस फील्ड में कदम रखा तभी पता था इंग्लिश जरूरी है। लेकिन इतना पैसा नहीं था कि कोई कोर्स ज्वाइन कर पाऊं। टाइम भी नहीं था, जल्दी जॉब करके पैसा कमाना था। इसलिए मैंने सिर्फ ₹1 से इंग्लिश सीखी। [Sir, when I stepped into this field, I knew English was important. But I didn't have enough money to join a course. I didn't have time either, I had to earn money quickly by getting a job. That's why I learned English for just ₹1.] Speaker A: सिर्फ ₹1 से? कैसे? [For just ₹1? How?] Speaker B: English Seekho ऐप से। एक दोस्त ने बताया था। ₹1 का ट्रायल था, सोचा ₹1 से क्या होगा करके देखता हूं। सुबह ऑफिस से निकलने से पहले 15 मिनट, रात को लौटने के बाद AI कोच से प्रैक्टिस। गलत बोलता था सुधार देती थी। कभी मेरा मजाक नहीं उड़ाया, कभी मुझे नीचा नहीं दिखाया। मेडिकल लाइन की इंग्लिश स्पेसिफिकली सीखी। पिछले 6 महीने से लगातार यूज़ कर रहा हूं, इंप्रूवमेंट आप देख ही सकते हैं। [From English Seekho app. A friend told me. There was a ₹1 trial, I thought what's the harm in trying for ₹1. 15 minutes before leaving for office in the morning, and practicing with the AI coach after returning at night. If I spoke incorrectly, it corrected me. It never made fun of me, never looked down on me. I specifically learned medical-line English. I've been using it continuously for the last 6 months, you can see the improvement yourself.] Speaker A: बढ़िया है यार! ऐप का नाम क्या बताया था? [That's great, man! What did you say the app's name was?] Speaker B: English Seekho. Speaker A: मैं भी अपने बेटे के लिए डाउनलोड करता हूं। [I will also download it for my son.] Speaker C: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: An angry customer insults a pharmacist's English skills, but the pharmacist calmly responds in fluent English, explaining that he learned using the English Seekho app's AI coach for just 1 Rupee. Impressed by his progress, the customer asks for the app's name to download it for his son.
